title: Caricature Iterations
content: It often takes four or five tries at a caricature to before a theme emerges. Then it's a matter of simplifying.Tony DeMarco,fiddler in the Irish tradition from NYCTony was talking and moving as he played a concert, so I had a chance to observe him in a variety of angles and expressions.If you want a reality check, you can watch Tony talk and fiddleon this YouTube video.
